name: Height
overview: Scripture presents height both literally and figuratively, emphasizing Jesus' growth in stature and wisdom as part of His human development (Luke 2:52). It also uses height symbolically in describing the perfect dimensions of the New Jerusalem, highlighting God's order and completeness (Revelation 21:16). Most profoundly, height is mentioned in Romans as one of many dimensions that cannot separate believers from the love of God in Christ Jesus, underscoring the inseparability of God's love from all circumstances (Romans 8:38-39). These verses together affirm that height, whether physical or metaphorical, is under God's sovereign design and cannot hinder His redemptive work.
